How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our Global Platform Solutions (GPS) Marketing team and feel like you are part of something bigger. About your team The GPS Research & Insights team provides a range of key research roles, such as managing and delivering customer research programmes to help us understand our customers (B2C (Business to customer) and B2B (Business to business), benchmarking against competitors and monitoring market trends. title: Global HR Operations Associate - Contingent Workforce
description: Who We Are Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact. To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive. What You'll Do BCG’s central Contingent Workforce team, branded as Contingent IQ, supports the engagement and onboarding of contingent workers and client-facing contractors across BCG. Together with the Global HR Shared Services Center (HRSSC) function that supports the internal employee lifecycle and operations, we are enhancing every individual’s journey at BCG. The HR Operations Associate will be supporting the back-end processing of contingent worker requests. This role is responsible for coordinating and executing operational activities across onboarding, supplier registration, system processing, renewals, and offboarding, while helping ensure that requests are handled accurately, compliantly, and in a timely manner. Key role & responsibilities Daily management of operational activities supporting contingent worker and client-facing contractor onboarding Reviewing intake information to ensure requests are complete, accurate, and aligned to the correct process path Completing required activities in operational systems and tools, including supplier onboarding and requisition-related support in Coupa. Capturing, validating, and maintaining accurate supplier, contract, stakeholder, and service-related information across systems, trackers, and supporting documentation. Monitoring shared mailboxes, trackers, and operational queues to ensure timely and accurate case progression. Responding to operational queries from stakeholders and providing clear status updates on active requests. Maintaining strong data integrity across relevant systems and identifying gaps, errors, or missing information for follow-up. Maintaining personnel records in compliance with legal requirements and internal standards. Producing basic reports and responding to data or status requests from key stakeholders and supporting internal audits with required documentation and timely response. What You'll Bring A Graduate degree or equivalent. 1-3 years of experience in HR operations, contingent workforce operations, shared services, stakeholder operations, procurement coordination, or a related operational environment. Ability to work flexible hours, as needed, to provide effective global coverage. Excellent written and spoken English communication skills. Proficiency in MS Office, especially Outlook, Excel, and PowerPoint. Experience working in a global multinational is preferred. Demonstrated integrity, professionalism, and a strong service mindset. Desirable: Basic experience with contingent workforce processes, supplier onboarding, contractor lifecycle operations, shared mailboxes, service management, Coupa, Workday, Fieldglass, or related tools. Additional info This role requires someone who thrives in a structured, matrixed global organization and can manage detail-heavy operational work while collaborating across teams: Work effectively within a global, cross-cultural, and virtual environment. Demonstrate a strong customer focus and effective stakeholder management skills. Exhibit exceptional attention to detail and a disciplined approach to operational accuracy. Communicate clearly and professionally with a range of stakeholders across teams and functions. Thriving under pressure with exceptional attention to detail. Staying flexible and reliable in a dynamic and changing environment. Handling sensitive data with confidentiality and professionalism. At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development. For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices. We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws. title: Intern
description: Position Name – Training Operations & Documentation Intern – Crompton Samrudhi 1. Brief about the position: The Training Operations & Documentation Intern will support the delivery of one-day Crompton Samrudhi technician upskilling programmes across South India. The role focuses on participant registration, attendance, assessment coordination, digital data entry, evidence capture, documentation and batch closure. Interns will work alongside external/freelance trainers so trainers can focus primarily on technical training delivery, while operational and documentation requirements are completed as per the project SOP. 2. About the Crompton Samrudhi Project: The project delivers structured technical and product upskilling for existing field technicians across the South Region. Each batch is planned as a one-day programme with an average batch size of 30 participants. The current planning target is to train 4,000 participants by 31 December 2026, subject to the approved rollout calendar. The internship is intended to support batch operations and reporting through project closure. Post this tenure based on the project requirements the tenure can be considered to extent on the same project or any other relevant project, if applicable. · Job type: Fixed-term internship for the project period; final terms to be confirmed by HR. · Total vacancies: 4 nos. · Immediate joiners preferred, subject to availability and project mobilisation timelines. 3. Job Description: · Pre-Training Coordination: Coordinate with the project team and trainer to check the batch schedule, venue readiness, participant list, training materials, branding, practical tools and stationery. · Participant Registration & Records: Support registration and check completeness of required participant details and documents as per the approved process; flag missing or inconsistent records for follow-up. · Digital Registration Support: Assist participants with Skill India Digital Hub and Crompton Saathi/Sathi App registration where applicable; escalate portal, mobile or OTP issues. · Attendance & Batch Administration: Manage the registration desk, attendance sheets, participant list, batch IDs and records for distribution of approved materials such as T-shirts, badges or toolkits. · Assessment Coordination: Support pre/post-test and external assessment logistics; compile candidate-wise data and share the required batch-wise Excel sheets within the timeline set by the project manager. · Documentation & Digital Filing: Update approved Excel/Google Sheets and Zoho trackers where applicable; maintain batch-wise Google Drive folders and upload attendance, registration, assessment, scheme-linkage and stipend-related records. · Photo, Video & Evidence Capture: Capture clear geo-tagged photographs and videos of training activities, practical demonstrations and group photographs; upload evidence to the approved project folder on the same day where connectivity allows. · Trainee Case Studies: Record at least three trainee case-study/testimonial videos per batch, with participant consent, covering prior work, skills learned, expected benefits and overall feedback. · Government Scheme Linkage: Coordinate with the designated scheme-linkage agency, where assigned, and update enrolment/referral status without promising eligibility or benefits. · Material & Benefit Records: Maintain distribution/receipt records for approved materials and flag discrepancies to the project coordinator. · Daily Reporting & Batch Closure: Share updates on attendance, registrations, assessments, evidence uploads, scheme linkage and open issues; use the batch closure checklist to identify missing documentation. · Data Confidentiality & Safety: Handle personal documents only through approved systems and channels, follow photo/video consent requirements and comply with data confidentiality and venue safety instructions. 4. Reporting and Team: Reporting to: Project Coordinator / Project Manager. The intern will coordinate day-to-day with assigned external/freelance trainers, venue contacts, mobilisation teams, assessment teams and the designated scheme-linkage agency, as required. The intern supports the process and does not replace the trainer’s technical delivery responsibilities or the project manager’s approval responsibilities. 5. Work Location, Language Spoken: Work location: South India, based on assigned state/cluster and the approved training calendar. Deployment may involve travel to training venues and nearby locations. · Language: Fluency in the local language of the assigned state/cluster is essential; working knowledge of English or Hindi is desirable. · Candidates must be comfortable communicating with adult technicians, freelance trainers, venue contacts and project stakeholders. · Travel: Willingness to undertake local and, where required, inter-city travel as per the project plan. 6. Skill Set: · Communication: Clear, polite communication in the local language and basic working English or Hindi. · Computer Skills: Basic-to-good working knowledge of MS Excel/Google Sheets, Google Forms, email and file/folder management. · Digital Documentation: Ability to scan documents, organise files, follow naming conventions and maintain accurate trackers. · Field Coordination: Ability to manage participant flow, attendance, materials and training-day logistics. · Photo/Video Skills: Comfortable using a smartphone to capture clear photos/videos and geo-tagged evidence; basic video handling is an advantage. · Personal Attributes: Organised, reliable, detail-oriented, proactive and able to work to same-day deadlines. · Data Handling: Understands the importance of confidentiality when working with participant identity and bank-related documents. 7. Grade & Salary: Stipend / monthly compensation: To be finalised by HR (tentatively 18 to 22 thousand monthly) Travel reimbursement, mobile/data allowance, working days, weekly off and any overnight travel arrangements should be confirmed in the internship offer. 8. Qualification & Experience: Final-year student, recent graduate or diploma holder in any discipline. Candidates from Business Administration, Commerce, Social Work, Rural Development, IT/Computer Applications, Data Management or Operations will be preferred. Prior experience in event coordination, field surveys, skilling programmes, CSR projects, training administration or data entry is an advantage but not mandatory. 9. KPI: · Batch documentation completeness: All mandatory batch records uploaded or missing items clearly flagged for every assigned batch. · Timely evidence submission: Geo-tagged photos/videos and core evidence uploaded on the training day, subject to connectivity. · Assessment data timeliness: Candidate-wise assessment sheet compiled and shared within the project manager’s prescribed cut-off; delays escalated promptly. · Data accuracy: Participant details, attendance and assessment records cross-checked for missing entries, duplicates and mismatches. · Case-study requirement: Minimum three usable trainee case-study videos per batch, with consent and required discussion points covered. · Daily updates: Accurate status update shared with the reporting manager for each assigned batch/day, including blockers and pending actions. · Audit and compliance: Batch documentation passes internal review/audit; no unauthorised sharing or storage of participant data. Pay: ₹18,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month Benefits: Flexible schedule Work Location: In person

description: About Us: Radiant Design is a precision engineering and manufacturing solutions company with expertise in mold making, tooling, and machining. We are committed to training and developing young engineers into future leaders in tool room and manufacturing technology. Role Overview: We are hiring Graduate Engineer Trainees (GETs) for our Tool Room division. The role offers hands-on exposure to machining, tooling, mold base manufacturing, and quality practices, with structured mentorship and career growth opportunities. Key Responsibilities: Assist in tool room operations including mold manufacturing, assembly, and maintenance. Operate and learn CNC, VMC, EDM, and conventional machines under supervision. Support senior engineers in precision machining and inspection activities. Learn to read and interpret engineering drawings and tool designs. Maintain quality standards and follow shop floor safety practices. Participate in continuous improvement and productivity initiatives. Eligibility: ITI, Diploma in Plastic/Tool & Die/Mechanical/Production/Manufacturing/Mechatronics. 0–1 year of experience (freshers welcome). Knowledge of machining processes and measuring instruments preferred. Good communication skills, willingness to learn, and adaptability. What We Offer: Comprehensive hands-on training in tool room and mold manufacturing. Mentorship from experienced engineers. Opportunity to work on precision engineering and tooling projects. Career growth within the organization. How to Apply: Interested candidates can send their resumes to hr@radiantdesign.in with the subject line: Application for GET – Tool Room . Job Types: Full-time, Fresher, Permanent Pay: ₹18,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month Benefits: Food provided Health insurance Paid sick time Paid time off Provident Fund Work Location: In person
